summary: TJGC Group Limited, a Hong Kong-based NASDAQ-listed advertising services foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026 disclosing that its board approved a share repurchase program of up to US$2,000,000 of Class A ordinary shares, equivalent to a US-style buyback authorization. Repurchases may occur via open market purchases, block trades, or privately negotiated transactions under Rule 10b-18, with possible Rule 10b5-1 plans; no price, share count, premium, or expiration is stated. The program has no time limit, is discretionary, and will be funded from existing cash. Watch execution pace, liquidity, and any concurrent insider selling or capital raise.
